correctness.rationale: Exact exhaustive enumeration gives 117 five-player weighted isomorphism classes, 17 Deegan–Packel local-monotonicity-violating classes, minimum three minimal winning coalitions, and one sparsest class. A second integer-weight generation route matches the full 117-class set, and the explicit witness is checked directly with exact rational arithmetic.

evidence: Freixas–Kurz, arXiv:1411.0944, Lemma 15 gives zero cost through four players and positive cost at five players for a Johnston/Deegan–Packel convex combination, with an explicit five-player weighted example.
broader_coverage.reasoning: That result establishes a broader cutoff/existence statement, but it does not enumerate all five-player Deegan–Packel violations, count their isomorphism classes, or classify the sparsest ones.

residual_risks: Unindexed theses, software-generated tables, or supplementary datasets could contain the same 17-class census or sparsest-class observation. Search failure alone is not a proof of novelty.

value.rationale: This is the complete classification at the first player count where Deegan–Packel local monotonicity can fail. It quantifies the violating fraction and identifies a unique structurally sparsest isomorphism class under the natural minimal-winning-coalition count, refining a known existence boundary into a reusable exact finite fact.
